title: Coordination
description: How the courier edge of a delivery is arranged across the process DAG. Composes on the delivery (parent) order; the courier order itself is just another buyer↔seller order. Single-select — an assembly composes exactly one coordination variant; variants are separate assemblies, never options inside one.

fields.name: coordination
fields.description: seller-assigned = the seller's regular courier (the seller's profile designates the counterparty). buyer-assigned = the buyer picks the courier at checkout. dutch-auction = an open auction with no prior relationship; the courier claiming the auction is the coordination trigger.
